name: SR and SEG — one display set for each version
notes: A series of structured reports or segmentations can hold more than one
version of the object. The default rules make one display set for each
With these rules, each SR or SEG instance becomes its own display set. The
display sets are in the order of ContentDate and ContentTime, so the
newest version is last. `isLatestVersion` is true on the display set of
the newest version of the series.
`contentStamp` is ContentDate and ContentTime as one number,

Each rule keeps the handler of the default rule, so the host builds the
display set with its SR or SEG code.
Priority -1: the rules run before every default rule.
